reviewStatus: candidate — visual review required; not guaranteed pixel-clean
edgePolicy: Preserve all alpha>0 diagnostics and alpha>=16 material warnings. Any alpha>=128 boundary pixel is a hard failure. Alpha 16–127 boundary pixels require review but are not automatically clipping and do not cause a nonzero exit. Alpha 1–15 residue alone does not fail. Technical failures also cause exit 1. Passing does not establish production readiness.

measurementNotes: Coordinates are cell-local, zero-based and inclusive. Baseline is the bottommost qualifying pixel (may include residue/shadows, not semantic foot detection). Edge intervals are extents, not necessarily contiguous. Histogram counts each boundary pixel once; side counts include corners on both sides. Higher thresholds supplement, never suppress, alpha>0 warnings.
